full_judgment:
72. A duty is cast upon prosecution to explore every avenue open to it to unveil truth and bring to book the real offenders and to advance cause of justice. Witnesses who can throw sufficient light in unfolding truth are to be produced before witness box as prosecution witnesses. Non examination of material witnesses shall give rise to a strong presumption against prosecution case in respect of involvement of an accused in the felony allegedly committed by him. If a material witness who would unroll the genesis of incident is not convincingly brought to fore otherwise or where there is a gap or infirmity in the prosecution case which could have been supplied or provided by examining a witness who, though available, is not examined, prosecution case can be termed as suffering from a serious deficiency and infirmity and withholding of such material and vital witness would oblige the Court to draw an adverse inference against the prosecution by holding that if the witness would have been examined he would not have supported the prosecution case as projected. 

 75. Failure to produce the vital and material witnesses stated in the foregoing paragraphs before Court without any explanation and reason in the background and fact and circumstances of the case was a serious reflection and fatal to the fabric of prosecution case and an adverse inference against prosecution case for non-examination of the above witness legitimately might arise and virtually arose. The inevitable legal presumption is that if the witnesses and persons stated above would have been examined they would not have definitely supported the prosecution case in bridgment of convict-appellants in causing the homicidal death of deceased Faruque. On this score, also, convict-appellants are entitled to get the benefit of doubt.
